title: Universal polynomial standardizer and its improved presentation
statement: Let k be a field, A a finitely presented commutative k-algebra, Λ any commutative k-algebra, d a natural number and N>0. Write S=k[x_0,...,x_(d-1)]. There exist s, generators a_j (j in Fin s) of singularIdeal k A, a commutative algebra B in Type(max u v) over k,A,S with compatible towers, and an A-presentation P on variables Fin d ⊕ (Fin d × Fin s) and relations Fin d. The first generators are the images of X_i under S→B, and the i-th relation is x_i^(2N)-sum_j z_ij a_j. There exist C₀ in Type(max u v), compatible k- and S-algebra structures, finite presentation over S, β₀:A→C₀ over k, ρ:C₀→B over S, and c>0 such that ρβ₀ equals the coefficient map A→B. For every commutative k-algebra R in Type u with compatible S→R→Λ structures and every S-algebra map h:B→Λ, put C=R⊗_S C₀ and γ the R-algebra tensor lift of hρ. Then popescuIdeal of h restricted to A is contained in popescuIdeal γ. For every x in R that is zero or the image of some X_i^c, its image in C is strictly standard over R. The notions of presentation, singular ideal, Popescu ideal, strict standardness and algebra tensor product are those of the cited statement dependencies.

proof.text: A is Noetherian because it is finitely presented over the field k. Choose finitely many generators a_j of H = singularIdeal k A. For any d and positive N, form the actual quotient B = A[x_i,z_ij]/(x_i^(2N)-sum_j z_ij a_j), and its quotient presentation P over A. The k[x]-structure sends X_i to the class of x_i. The presentation has exactly the displayed generator values and relations.

On the a_j-open solve uniquely for z_ij as a_j^(-1)(x_i^(2N)-sum_(l≠j)z_il a_l). This gives a polynomial algebra over A_(a_j) after base change to k[x], hence a smooth k[x]-algebra. On each x_i-open, the a_j generate the unit ideal by the defining relation, so the smooth a_j-opens cover and B_(x_i) is smooth.

Apply improvement of presentation over S=k[x] to obtain the explicit conormal symmetric algebra C₀, its inclusion of B and its retraction ρ. Set β₀ to A→B→C₀. The retraction gives ρβ₀ equal to the coefficient map A→B. C₀ is finite type over the Noetherian ring S and hence finitely presented. Its smooth x_i-opens have finite free differentials. Take a common positive exponent c above the finitely many strict-standard bounds from 07EZ(e). For d=0 choose c=1. These actual finite polynomial quotients and symmetric algebras lie in Type(max u v).

For any compatible base change S→R, the smooth a_j-opens persist in C=R⊗_S C₀. Thus the image of H is contained in singularIdeal R C. Extend along the tensor lift of hρ and take radicals to obtain the displayed Popescu-ideal inclusion. Base change preserves finite presentation and strict standardness of x_i^c. Zero is strictly standard: choose any finite presentation and c=0 in the strict-standard definition, with all minor coefficients zero. Its lift lies in the relation ideal, so its product with each relation lies in its square.

theorem exists_popescu_universal_standardizer
    {k : Type u} {A : Type v} {Λ : Type w}
    [Field k] [CommRing A] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k Λ]
    [FinitePresentation k A] (d N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    let S := MvPolynomial (Fin d) k
    ∃ (s : ℕ) (a : Fin s → A), Ideal.span (Set.range a) = singularIdeal k A ∧
      ∃ (B : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : Algebra k B)
        (_ : Algebra A B) (_ : IsScalarTower k A B)
        (_ : Algebra S B) (_ : IsScalarTower k S B)
        (P : Presentation A B (Fin d ⊕ (Fin d × Fin s)) (Fin d)),
        (∀ i, P.val (Sum.inl i) = algebraMap S B (MvPolynomial.X i)) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin d, P.relation i =
          ((MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inl i) :
            MvPolynomial (Fin d ⊕ (Fin d × Fin s)) A) ^ (2 * N) -
            ∑ j : Fin s, MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr (i, j)) * MvPolynomial.C (a j) :
              MvPolynomial (Fin d ⊕ (Fin d × Fin s)) A)) ∧
      ∃ (C₀ : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing C₀) (_ : Algebra k C₀)
        (_ : Algebra S C₀) (_ : IsScalarTower k S C₀)
        (_ : FinitePresentation S C₀)
        (β₀ : A →ₐ[k] C₀) (ρ : C₀ →ₐ[S] B) (c : ℕ),
        0 < c ∧ (ρ.restrictScalars k).comp β₀ = IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A B ∧
        ∀ (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [Algebra S R]
          [IsScalarTower k S R] [Algebra R Λ] [IsScalarTower k R Λ]
          [Algebra S Λ] [IsScalarTower S R Λ] [IsScalarTower k S Λ]
          (h : B →ₐ[S] Λ),
          let C := R ⊗[S] C₀
          let γ := AlgHom.liftEquiv S R C₀ Λ (h.comp ρ)
          popescuIdeal ((h.restrictScalars k).comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A B)) ≤
              popescuIdeal γ ∧
            ∀ x : R, (x = 0 ∨ ∃ i : Fin d,
              x = algebraMap S R (MvPolynomial.X i ^ c)) →
              IsStrictlyStandardElement (R := R) (algebraMap R C x)
